items.question: Do you offer free trial lessons before subscribing?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a free trial lesson for any course, plus a preview of the first video in each unit, so you can evaluate the content and instructor before subscribing.

items.question: What devices and systems are supported to access the platform?
items.answer: The platform is compatible with all devices (computer, tablet, smartphone) and works on modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). We also support offline mode via our app to download lessons in advance.

items.question: Can a parent track the student's progress?
items.answer: Yes, parents get an account linked to the student's account, allowing them to track watched lessons, test results, completed exercises, and periodic evaluations from teachers.

items.question: What if I miss a live session? Can I watch it later?
items.answer: Absolutely. All live sessions are recorded and uploaded automatically within an hour after they end, and remain available for life within the subscribed course.

items.question: Are the certificates accredited by the Ministry of Education or official educational institutions?
items.answer: Certificates are internally accredited by our platform and electronically signed by the teacher and educational coordinator. We are currently working on partnerships with accredited educational institutions to officially accredit some courses.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.description: The Learning Platform is your first destination for modern digital education. We provide a comprehensive educational environment that combines traditional teaching and interactive online learning, aiming to empower learners of all ages to acquire knowledge and develop skills in a flexible and user-friendly environment.
AboutPage.section_intro_paragraph2: Our platform was established to make high-quality education accessible to everyone, regardless of geographical location or social status. We believe that education is the driving force for progress, and we strive to provide resources and educational tools that help learners achieve their academic and professional goals.
AboutPage.mission_text: Our mission is to empower learners by providing outstanding educational content and interactive learning experiences. We aim to change the way we learn and teach others by integrating technology with best educational practices to deliver a rich and impactful learning experience.
AboutPage.vision_text: Our vision is to be a global leader in digital education, working to empower millions of learners worldwide by providing high-quality content and educational opportunities accessible to all.
features: Diverse educational content covering various disciplines and levels
Qualified and expert teachers in their fields
An interactive and multimedia learning environment
AboutPage.why_us_paragraph1: We stand out by offering a personalized learning experience that meets the needs of every learner. We use the latest technologies to ensure content quality and ease of access. We work with the best teachers and experts to provide exceptional courses that help you achieve your professional and educational goals.
AboutPage.why_us_paragraph2: We believe that learning never ends, and we strive to provide an inspiring environment that helps you continue to grow and develop in your educational and professional journey.

Your account information may not be used by anyone else. You may not create accounts for others without their explicit permission. We reserve the right to terminate user accounts that violate this policy.

It is prohibited to use any software, tools, or automated means to access our platform, attempt to measure its performance or content, or obtain information from it other than by the means we provide or authorize.

You may terminate your account at any time by giving us written notice. In the event of termination, we will delete your account information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro1: At our learning platform, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This privacy policy outlines the information we collect from you, why we collect it, how we use it, and your rights regarding this information.
PrivacyPage.intro2: By using our learning platform, you agree to the collection and use of your information in accordance with this privacy policy. If you do not agree with this policy, you should stop using the platform.
PrivacyPage.personalInfo: When you register on our platform or create an account, we may ask you to provide personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, and payment details. We use this information to provide our services to you and improve your experience on the platform.
PrivacyPage.nonPersonalInfo: We also collect non-personal information related to your experience on the platform, such as device information, browser type, IP address, and your use of the services. We use this information for analysis and improvement purposes.
PrivacyPage.usageIntro: We use the information we collect from you for the following purposes:
usageList: To provide and improve our services and your experience on the platform
To communicate with you about updates and new services
To personalize content and services according to your interests
To analyze platform usage and improve its performance
To prevent illegal or prohibited activities
PrivacyPage.thirdParty1: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for commercial purposes. However, we may share your information with trusted parties who help us operate our platform, conduct our business, or provide services to you, provided that these parties agree to adhere to the same privacy standards.
PrivacyPage.thirdParty2: We may disclose your personal information in the following cases: (1) to comply with the law or respond to court orders, (2) to protect the rights, property, or safety of users or others, (3) to investigate violations of our policies.
PrivacyPage.security1: We take appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We use encryption technologies and other security protocols to ensure the safety of your data. However, information security cannot be guaranteed 100% when transmitted over the internet.
PrivacyPage.security2: Securing access to your account is your responsibility. We recommend using strong, hard-to-guess passwords and not sharing your login information with others.
PrivacyPage.cookies1: We use cookies and other technologies to enhance your experience on the platform and analyze its performance. Cookies help us remember your preferences, collect analytical information, and provide personalized content. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but some platform features may be affected.
PrivacyPage.cookies2: We use analytics services such as Google Analytics to collect information about how visitors use the platform. This information is used for analysis and to improve the user experience.
PrivacyPage.access1: You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you and request its correction or update if it is inaccurate. You can also request the deletion of your personal information from our records, unless we are legally required to retain it.
PrivacyPage.access2: To access or request changes to your information, please contact us using the contact information provided below.
PrivacyPage.retention1: We retain your personal information only as long as we need it to provide our services to you or as required by legal obligations. Once the information is no longer needed for our purposes, we delete it securely.
PrivacyPage.retention2: We may retain some personal information for a longer period to comply with legal requirements, resolve disputes, or protect our rights.
PrivacyPage.children1: Our platform is not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and suspect that your child has provided personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.
PrivacyPage.children2: If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will delete this information from our records immediately.
PrivacyPage.changes1: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page. We encourage you to review the privacy policy periodically to stay informed of the latest updates.
PrivacyPage.changes2: Your continued use of the platform after changes are made constitutes your acceptance of the updated policies.
